issue_request: FHIR-15144 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for STU3 ValueSet.expansion.parameter asking that expansion parameters include all parameters, including server defaults, used by the server to generate an expansion.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-15144, and Jira records the request as already done. Nearby 2018 commits added the ValueSet expansion-parameter narrative and then broadened it to all parameters affecting the $expand operation before the Jira already-done comment.
additional_context: FHIR-16443 clarified server-assigned names for additional default or server-supplied parameters, and FHIR-41589 later replaced the broad server-default wording with the current SHOULD list for used client inputs, server-defaulted input values, and terminology artifacts used in an expansion. FHIR-41589 minutes confirm the work group intentionally preserved SHOULD rather than requiring parameters by default.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Active ValueSet source and the $expand return documentation already include the current minimum SHOULD guidance and link the operation output to the ValueSet Expansion Parameters section.
